paite: Zahngaihna leh vaihawmna dik thu la in ka sa ding a; TOUPA aw, nangmah phat in la ka sa ding.
heading: David Phatna La / Kumpipa Thuchiam

paite: Lam hoihkim ah piltak in ka om ding. Aw chikchiang in ahia ka kiang a na hong pai ding? Ka insung ah lungtang hoihkim pu in ka om ding hi.
Thil hoihloute ka mitmuh ah ka koih kei ding, lampialte thilhih ka hua ahi; keimah ah abang kei ding hi.
Lungtang genhak in hon paisan ding a; thil gilou himhim ka thei kei ding hi.
Kuapeuh a-invengte aguk a gen, huai mi ka hihmang ding a; mi mit tunghah leh lungtang kisathei pumi ka thuak thei kei ding hi.
Hiai gam a mi muanhuaite tung ah ka mit atu ding a, ka kiang a a-omtheihna ding un; lam hoihkim tawnmi in ka nna asem ding hi.
Khem hat ka insung ah a-om kei ding a; ka mitmuh ah mizuauhat hihkip in a-om kei ding hi.
Zingsang teng in hiai gam a migilou-salou tengteng ka hihmang ding a; TOUPA khopi a kipan thil hihkhial tengteng hihmang ding in.
